relations.subject: Dzigar Kongtrul Rinpoche
relations.evidence: He was trained in the Longchen Nyingtik lineage of the Nyingma school as well as the Khyen-Kong Chok-Sum lineages... by his root guru H.H. Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche.

relations.subject: Dzigar Kongtrul Rinpoche
relations.evidence: Rinpoche also studied extensively under Tulku Urgyen Rinpoche, Nyoshul Khen Rinpoche and the great scholar Khenpo Rinchen.
